text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Demon King, defeated by the hero 
Machan, left behind these final words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, was once a hero. I shall surely 
fulfill my mission," she said—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And that concludes our recitation 
drama, "The Adventures of the Brave 
Machan."

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeh~! That's awesooome!! The Demon King 
used to be the Hero?!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, when are you going to tell me 
the rest of the Demon King story?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, the Demon King ended up stealing 
the spotlight. Even though I stayed up all 
night making it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with a reaction unlike what she 
expected, Aston Machan's shoulders slumped 
in disappointment...
